## F4 Spray Paint — Changelog (25.06.2026)

### New Features

Paint Bucket Tool
Added a new Paint Bucket Tool that allows players to instantly fill the entire background with any selected color.

UI Crosshair
Added a crosshair to the painting UI for improved drawing precision.

---

### Bug Fixes

Spray Replacement
Fixed an issue where players were unable to create a new spray after deleting an existing one.

---

### Internal Changes

- Added the Paint Bucket Tool
- Added a UI crosshair for more accurate painting
- Improved spray replacement logic after deletion
